name: DCA Smokejumpers Grill (Grizzly Peak) Plain Angus Cheeseburger, Chicken Tenders or Breakfast Sandwich
brandOrRestaurant: Smokejumpers Grill (Grizzly Peak · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Right next to Soarin', Smokejumpers serves plain Angus cheeseburgers on toasted brioche (or allergy-friendly gluten-free buns), waffle/crinkle fries, and a morning Egg-Bacon-Cheddar Brioche Breakfast Sandwich.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the Classic Breakfast Sandwich with **NO green chile sauce**; for lunch/dinner, order a plain Cheeseburger with cheddar only (skip the Spicy Buffalo Chicken and Jalapeño Bacon burgers).
watchOuts: Morning breakfast sandwich comes with green chile sauce by default—always toggle "No Green Chile" in Mobile Order!
